data.name: Variant Channeling - Death
data.description: Heal - Creatures gain a +%1 channel bonus on stabilization checks when dying and on saves against death effects for 1 minute. Harm - Creatures gain a -%1 channel penalty on stabilization checks when dying for 1 minute, and subtract the channel penalty from all healing magic, fast healing, and regeneration.|ChannelModifier
